annotation.title_clean: White Paper des Österreichischen Rats für Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz
annotation.title_en: White Paper of the Austrian Council on Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Österreichischer Rat für Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz (BMVIT advisory council)
annotation.summary_en: First white paper of the Austrian Council on Robotics and AI, advising the transport and innovation ministry (BMVIT). It sets out three pillars (smart governance, innovation, regulation) and four priority fields for a national robotics and AI strategy. It recommends incremental strategy-making, public participation, state investment, and new European standards that do not hinder innovation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends an incremental strategy process with continuous research and technology monitoring
Calls for broad stakeholder and citizen participation to raise acceptance, citing the Montreal Declaration
Calls for targeted state investment and innovation funding, with attention to SMEs
Smart regulation: develop new European standards where existing ones are insufficient, without hindering innovation
Technology must ensure human safety and comply with ethics, fundamental rights and European values
